newsitem.title: USA: Rhode Island says Treasury employee finds $2.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Rhode Island says Treasury employee finds $2.5 mln.

text.p: Rhode Island's Treasurer on Tuesday said that the U.S. government has repaid the state $2.5 million after a state employee found that it had overpaid withholding taxes from 1981 to 1986.

"Carol Dutra is a model employee worth her weight in gold to Rhode Island taxpayers," said the state's General Treasurer, Nancy Mayer, in prepared remarks. She was referring to the state department's employee.
Dutra, who is responsible for the department's back-office operations, found the overpayment during a routine review of old records.
Rhode Island's budget for the 1997 fiscal year totaled $3.6 billion .
